rows.question: Run a load test of the new checkout against the payment provider's test environment at the expected sale-day order rate and its calls per order, and ask the provider in writing what rate limits and fraud rules apply to your account on sale day.
rows.note: Payment provider load and limits; no fact concerns this

rows.question: Is there a server-side feature flag that can switch the new checkout off for all app versions within minutes without a store release, and has the team tested switching it on and off in production?
rows.note: Feature flag rollback; unrelated to the facts

rows.question: Check the beta build on a set of older and low-end Android and iOS devices (the ones in your sale-week analytics top 20) and confirm the payment sheet renders and completes an order on each.
rows.note: Asks for a device test, not about dashboard coverage; f3 not directly stated

rows.question: Beyond crashes, what do the beta's order logs show for checkout step drop-off, payment errors, timeouts and frozen screens compared with the current checkout? Query these directly and compare the rates.
rows.note: Order-log failure rates; no fact addressed

rows.question: Who was in the beta (how they joined, device types, sample size, how long it ran) and does the 8% lift hold when you compare only against a matched group of non-beta users with similar past spending?
rows.note: Who was in the beta and how long it ran directly elicits f1 and f2

rows.question: Has the new checkout been tested with sale discount codes, bundles and promotional pricing, including the specific code path that applies stacked discounts, in a staging environment?

Ask the app store review contacts or look at your own last ten submissions: what were the actual review times (median and worst case), and does the payment-flow change trigger a special policy review? What is the latest submission date that still leaves a buffer of several days?

What share of your 2 million users are on the current app version and how fast did the last update spread, in days to reach 50 and 80 percent? Check the version-adoption chart from the previous release.

Do the deep links in the push notification work correctly in both the old and new app versions against the new backend? Tap the link on a phone with the old version installed and on one with the new version.

Put numbers on both sides: what is the expected sale-week revenue gain from the 8% lift at your normal conversion, and what is the revenue lost per hour of a checkout outage in sale week; at what outage length does shipping lose?
